modules.module_title: Handling Jute bales and grade wise stacking

pcs.pc_description: bring the following tools/equipment required for the task Tools/ Equipment: Chopper/Knife- for root cutting, wooden block- for chopping, set of spikes- for hackling, nose mask, hook for bale movement, trolley-for bring the bales from godown and for stacking grade-wise selected jute (barrow)
bring the jute bales from godown to the selection spot using the specified material handling equipment
remove the bale ropes using the specified tool/knife, cut them to open the bales without damaging jute fibres
open the knots of ropes and place them separately for further processing
dispose the jute bale ropes to the specified place as per Sardar's/Supervisor's instruction
keep separately the entangled jute fibres (Habijabi), if found within the bale
keep Marka (a written tag for grade of jute and its mokam) at the appropriate place for reference
transport the specified number of bales of selected grade from one place to another as per the instruction of Sardar (Jobber) or Supervisor
weigh the bales, if necessary, as per supervisor's instruction

modules.module_title: Sort and cut raw Jute for further processing

pcs.pc_description: identify the approximate root portion (approximate weight %) in bundles of raw jute strand (Reed) in morah and chop the root portion (correct length of root portion is to be ensured) by a chopper or knife, depending on next process whether to Softener or Spreader and yarn quality to make (as per instruction received) and keep the root portion at appropriate place for further processing
hackle the entangled jute reed/strand for proper cleaning and opening each bundle for proper selection and grading
select raw jute bundles in proper manner giving due importance to each quality parameter and defects etc
ensure by hand and eye method the following quality parameters of raw jute fibres during selection, Strength, Root content, Defects, Colour, Fineness, Bulk- Density
ensure that after proper selection of jute bundle, each morah (approx. 1500 200 gms) is half twisted and folded at the middle before stacking for further processing to keep grade-wise
ensure that raw jute after selection is to be kept in dry and clean conditions
ensure that barrows with selected morahs be marked with proper identification mark, to avoid mixing up of one quality of jute fibre morahs with other quality morahs

any anomalies to be reported to the Sardar (Jobber) or Supervisor, e.g. the unavailability of jute bales of a particular grade as required for processing of a specific yarn count, has to be reported to the next senior
